hero3.pill: Navigation, buses, voice and accessible maps, one app
hero3.titleA: Where to go. How to get there.
hero3.sub: ConnectRwanda AI brings smart navigation, public transport guidance, a voice assistant and accessible maps together, so everyone can move around Rwanda, discover places and reach essential services on their own.

problem.quote: Where to go, how to get there, when the bus comes, and whether the place is accessible: four questions, no single place to answer them.
problem.body: Rwanda’s cities are growing fast, but urban information is scattered. Finding a destination, a reliable bus or a nearby service is hard, and harder still for people with disabilities.
problem.p1Body: Finding a destination and navigating unfamiliar places is difficult without clear, local directions.
problem.p2Body: Without real-time bus locations or arrival times, waiting at the stop is long and uncertain.
problem.p3Body: Nearby businesses and essential services are hard to locate, and many small shops have no digital presence.
problem.p4Body: Maps rarely say whether a place or route is accessible, so moving around independently is a challenge.
problem.aerialAlt: View over Kigali and its hills

solution.title: One AI platform to move, discover and get there.
solution.body: ConnectRwanda AI combines GPS, IoT devices, AI and community data in a single app that guides you from the question to the destination.
solution.s1Body: Find your destination and get clear step-by-step directions, on foot or by bus.
solution.s2Body: Nearby buses, routes and estimated arrival times, live on the map.
solution.s3Body: Just ask out loud in Kinyarwanda, French or English, and listen to the answer.
solution.s4Body: Accessible entrances, ramps and routes shown before you leave, improved by the community.
solution.innovation: Our innovation: all of these services in one platform, so people can move around, discover places and access essential services more easily and independently.

transit.title: Know exactly when your bus arrives.
transit.body: GPS and IoT trackers on board stream every bus position. AI estimates the arrival time at each stop, even in traffic.
transit.l1: Buses around you, live on the map
transit.l2: Estimated arrival time at your stop
transit.l3: Routes and the best way to your destination

ops.title: Informed passengers, a more efficient fleet.

ops.o3Body: Ridership, delays, busy routes: what you need to plan better service.

access.b3: Accessibility used as a ranking factor in every search

biz.title: Found because they fit you, not because they paid.
biz.body: The AI ranks restaurants, shops, markets and services by distance, accessibility, local ownership and your needs. Small businesses get seen, and owners manage their own listing.
biz.b1: Transparent ranking: distance, accessibility, local ownership, needs
biz.b2: Owners create and update their own listing at no cost
biz.b3: Small and informal businesses gain real digital visibility

who.title: Built for everyone who moves.
who.w1Body: Know when the bus comes and the best way to get there.
who.w2Body: Accessible routes, places and buses, plus a voice assistant.
who.w3Body: A free listing so nearby customers can find you.
who.w4Body: Live fleet data and a direct line to passengers.
who.body: ConnectRwanda AI serves the people who travel, the people who need accessible information, and the businesses and operators who keep the city moving.
who.w1a: Live arrival times at every stop
who.w1b: Door-to-door routes on foot and by bus
who.w2b: Full voice control in three languages
who.w3a: Free listing managed by the owner
who.w3b: Ranked fairly, next to larger brands
who.w4a: Real-time view of the whole fleet

tech.title: From the bus to your pocket, in seconds.
tech.body: A simple chain of data, designed to stay reliable on mobile networks across the country.
tech.n1d: Each bus sends its position every few seconds through a GPS and IoT tracker.
tech.n2d: The AI predicts arrival times, reads traffic and ranks places for each person.
tech.n3d: You see the result on the map, hear it by voice and follow the directions.

footer.about: An AI platform that brings navigation, public transport, voice assistance and accessible mapping together, so everyone can move around Rwanda independently.

map.sim: Live simulation on real Kigali roads

film.label: ConnectRwanda AI presentation film
film.c1: Kigali, 7:30 a.m. Thousands of people set out to work, study and shop.
film.c2: Too often, the questions come before the journey: where is the bus, which way, is it accessible?
film.c3: ConnectRwanda AI shows every bus live, with arrival times predicted by AI.
film.c4: It plans the whole journey, door to door, on foot and by bus.
film.c5: Ask out loud in Kinyarwanda, French or English, and hear the answer.
film.c6: Step-free entrances, ramps and accessible toilets are visible before you leave.
film.c7: One platform, so everyone can move around Rwanda independently.
